pages.text:
“Look, Daddy!
Pearl Castle!”

They landed at Sky Lagoon.
Together, they went to Pearl Castle.

Inside Pearl Castle,
dust covered the floor!
“Let’s clean it together!”

“One little job at a time,” said Daddy.
He gave Roshan a brush and a sponge.
pages.background_theme: One dust puff peeks around the pail on the left; folded cloth alone on the right. Curious anticipation, no duplicated foreground tools.

pages.text: First, Roshan drained the murky bath.

Round and round
went the sponge.
Roshan wiped
the sink clean.
pages.background_theme: Existing sink and sponge identify the surface being cleaned. Soap dish/comb bank retained; hand contact is still not illustrated.

pages.text:
Back and forth. Scrub, scrub!
Roshan brushed the empty tub clean.
pages.background_theme: Finishing the empty bath. LEFT bank: small yellow rubber duck with its visible dark eye from bottom-left reference cell, sitting level on a shallow bank shelf. RIGHT bank: rolled lavender towel from bottom-middle cell resting lengthwise along the slope, complete rounded end, contact shadow underneath. No folded cloths or soap dish.

pages.text:
Clean water sparkled in the bath.
The little bunny splashed happily.

The great pool was still murky.
Its rainbow waterfall had stopped.

Scoop, lift, and out it came!
Roshan gathered the floating rubbish.
pages.background_theme: Actual pool rubbish: torn star wrapper left; algae-covered dented can and discarded blue cap right. Replaces clean accessories and empty basket.

pages.text:
One lane clear!
Two more to go.

Whoooosh!
The waterfall
turned rainbow!

The seahorse fountain was blocked, too.
Roshan gently pulled the rubbish free.

The fountain flowed again.
Fresh water swirled. The pool was clear!
“Thank you for helping!” said Rumi.
A tiny chirp! “Someone needs help!”

Two dust bunnies held Baby Eagle.
“I’m here,” said Roshan. “I’ll help you.”

Roshan loosened one dusty bunny,
then the other. Little by little...

Baby Eagle
was free!
A little help made
a big difference.
pages.background_theme: Two dust puffs move outward, clearing space after Eagle's rescue. Small rolling and sheepish retreat reactions; no toys or second rescue.

pages.text:
Now there was room to play together.
“Come with me, Baby Eagle!”
pages.background_theme: Distinct existing waving Roshan pose invites Baby Eagle. Shared-cup bunny border retained.

pages.text:
The art room was messy, too.
Roshan sorted the brushes and paints.
pages.background_theme: Messy paint-jar silhouette in the foreground. Tipped pink bottle and paint-marked crumpled paper in the banks establish the untidy state before the clean-table payoff.

pages.text:
She put the supplies away.
Then she brushed the table clean.
pages.background_theme: Full art: existing Roshan/table brush-contact frame.

pages.text:
A splash of colour.
Her very own choice!

One last door
began to glow.
Beyond it came
a rumble...
pages.background_theme: One worried lavender bunny in lower right looks toward the rumbling door. No unrelated attic prop.

pages.text:
Grand Puff!
A great, big
bundle of dust!
Roshan took
a brave breath.
pages.background_theme: Two differently posed scared bunnies huddle in lower right beneath Grand Puff. Latest owner direction supersedes the former empty-bank reveal.

pages.text:
Boing! Roshan dodged the bounce.
Then she answered with a little sparkle.
pages.background_theme: Existing curled swimming Roshan pose and jumping Grand Puff form a separated action composite. Three lower-right bunnies duck, compress and recoil. Illustrative dodge cue, not a newly authored game frame.

pages.text:
Daddy, Rumi and Baby Eagle helped Roshan.
Four friends. Four busy helpers. Scrub, scrub!

Bubbles grew until Grand Puff was hidden.
Then something stirred inside...

POP! A little rainbow bunny jumped out!
The dusty casing tumbled into fluff.

Down came the bunny. Down settled the dust.
Four friends met one very small friend.

“We helped each other,” said Roshan.
“And found a friend hiding under all that dust!”
pages.background_theme: Existing conversational Roshan gesture replaces neutral standing pose; Daddy and puzzle-sharing border retained.

pages.text:
“Hello, little
rainbow friend.
Come and play
with us!”
pages.background_theme: One patchwork ball on left invites the new friend to play. Rainbow arch removed so the foreground newcomer owns the rainbow.
